origin.painorigin.deva_path.name: Deva Path (Pain)
origin.painorigin.deva_path.description: Bearer of the Rinnegan's Deva Path. You command repulsion and attraction through gravity, at the price of a frail body and a limited pool of chakra.
power.painorigin.chakra.name: Chakra
power.painorigin.chakra.description: A pool of 100 chakra powers every technique and regenerates about 2 per second. It is shown as a bar on the HUD.
power.painorigin.shinra_tensei.name: Shinra Tensei
power.painorigin.shinra_tensei.descripti: [Primary key] Release a repulsive shockwave that hurls everything within 10 blocks away and deals light damage. Cost: 10 chakra. Cooldown: 5 s. Breaks no blocks.
power.painorigin.shinra_tensei_massive.d: [Sneak + Primary key] Charge for 1.5 s, then unleash a huge repulsion (24 blocks, heavy damage). Cost: 40 chakra. Cooldown: 60 s. Block destruction is OFF by default (server config).
power.painorigin.bansho_tenin.name: Bansho Ten'in
power.painorigin.bansho_tenin.descriptio: [Secondary key] Pull the creature you are looking at toward you (up to 32 blocks). Targets behind walls cannot be selected. Cost: 8 chakra. Cooldown: 4 s.
power.painorigin.chibaku_tensei.name: Chibaku Tensei
power.painorigin.chibaku_tensei.descript: [Sneak + Secondary key] Create a gravity core that drags nearby creatures into a rock-like sphere and crushes them. Cost: 80 chakra. Cooldown: 3 min. Interrupted if you die, log out, change dimension or take a heavy hit.
power.painorigin.universal_defense.name: Universal Defense
power.painorigin.universal_defense.descr: A gravity barrier automatically negates one incoming attack, projectile or explosion (max 3 charges, +1 every 20 s, costs 5 chakra each). It does not stop falling, drowning, fire, magic, starvation or void damage.
Gravity warps around you: dropped items and experience within 6 blocks are drawn toward you.
power.painorigin.gravity_affinity.name: Gravity Affinity
power.painorigin.gravity_affinity.descri: You fall about 25% slower than normal.
power.painorigin.frail_vessel.name: Frail Vessel
power.painorigin.frail_vessel.descriptio: Your body is weak: maximum health reduced by 4 (2 hearts).
painorigin.notice.no_target: No target in sight (blocked by a wall, or out of range)
painorigin.onboarding:
Deva Path awakened.
Primary key: Shinra Tensei  |  Sneak + Primary: Massive Shinra Tensei
Secondary key: Bansho Ten'in  |  Sneak + Secondary: Chibaku Tensei
(Bind the Secondary key in Options > Controls > Origins; it is unbound by default.)
